Subject: Request — short extension & top-up while we finalize SOC2 answers

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We started a small integration and burned through the initial starter allowance faster than expected — great perf, but we underestimated token usage during vector refreshes.

Can Pollen AI get a short two-week extension on our trial allowance and a one-time 50k token top-up while we finish the SOC2 questionnaire and finalize procurement? We can share the updated DD attachments (usage snapshot attached) and commit to a paid Dedicated pilot if all goes well.

Attached: usage_snapshot_20261213.csv

Best,

Samira —

Appreciate the quick context and the snapshot. Short answer: likely yes, we can do a conditional extension + top-up while legal and security finish the SOC2 review. A couple quick asks so I can move this fast with our finance and GTM teams:

- Can you confirm expected peak tokens/day over the next 14 days?
- Are you comfortable with a short usage cap and automatic downgrade if the limit is exceeded?
- We usually require an MOU for pilot commitments — I can share a template.

Looping Laura on procurement and Karthik on technical ramp so we align on deliverables. I’ll come back with a concrete approval and any required redlines by end of day tomorrow.

—Markus

markus@redwood.ai
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request — short extension & top-up while we finalize SOC2 answers

Hi Samira / Markus,

Thanks for the attachment — Laura here from Revenue Ops. We can approve a timeboxed, conditional extension: 14 days from approval with a 50k token top-up. Standard conditions:

- We provision a soft cap at 65k tokens/day; exceeding the cap will trigger a notification and temporary throttle until you confirm (to avoid runaway spend).
- Request an MOU that lists the milestone: SOC2 questionnaire submitted + pilot kickoff call scheduled within the 14-day window.
- If you sign a Dedicated pilot contract within 45 days, we’ll credit the top-up toward the first month’s usage.

I’ve attached our MOU template (see MOU_PollenAI_v1.pdf). If you’re comfortable, sign and return and we’ll action the credit same-day.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.ai
From: Samira Noor <samira@pollenai.com>

Subject: Re: Request — short extension & top-up while we finalize SOC2 answers

Hi Laura / Markus —

Thanks — that sounds reasonable. Confirming expected peak: ~40–50k tokens/day for the next 10 days, then tapering to ~10–15k/day after the pilot ramp. We’re fine with the soft cap and milestone (SOC2 submission + kickoff).

I’ve signed the MOU locally (see attached draft), but our legal wants to clean up one bit on indemnity language — it’s minor. Can you route the MOU to your legal team and we’ll aim to return a countersigned copy within 48 hours?

I’ll also set up the pilot kickoff for Dec 28 to keep momentum.

Thanks,
Samira
